description: Source code for a Program Enrollment Tool in ERPNext, handling student retrieval and enrollment processes.

classes.name: ProgramEnrollmentTool
classes.description: A Document class for managing program enrollment operations, including loading data, fetching students, and enrolling students.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Initializes the form by setting the 'academic_term_reqd' flag based on Education Settings.

methods.name: get_students
methods.description: Retrieves students based on specified criteria, either from Student Applicant or Program Enrollment, excluding inactive students.

methods.name: enroll_students
methods.description: Enrolls selected students into a program, creating Program Enrollment documents or calling external enroll_student API.
